decisive_items: Positive for: human melanoma black-45, smooth muscle actin, and melanoma antigen recognized by T cells 1 (melan-A)
Negative for: hepatocyte paraffin 1, human arginase 1, S100, SRY-related HMG-box transcription factor 10, inhibin, and glypican-3
Liver biopsy showed islands of neoplastic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm
response.rationale: The immunostaining profile is diagnostic of melanoma (HMB-45 and Melan-A positive) and excludes hepatocellular carcinoma (Hep Par1, arginase-1, glypican-3 negative). The liver lesion with biopsy confirms metastatic melanoma to the liver.

rejected.why: Negative hepatocyte markers (Hep Par1, arginase-1, glypican-3) rule out hepatocellular carcinoma.
Smooth muscle actin positivity is nonspecific; melanoma markers are more definitive.
Duplicate of champion diagnosis; same evidence.
Fatty liver disease does not explain the neoplastic biopsy or melanoma markers.
